scope: Independent review and suggestions; no AI/UI implementation or release changes.

findings.title: Part-only stack changes whole-body zones
findings.repro: matte black on the roof only with a fine hex texture
findings.observed: Use-kit base item targets body; apply emits edit_zone for body z5/z6 to matte black plus add_zone for roof spec texture. Snake scales on the hood only in gold similarly emits gold body changes and clears existing body patterns.
findings.suggestion: Bind scope to each requested layer. Keep all layers on the named part for part-only asks; use a whole-body base only when explicitly requested. Assert unchanged outside-part zones and pixels.

findings.title: Typed element replies do not execute card actions
repro: there are none on this paint
observed: unknown look there none; confirmation still pending
findings.suggestion: Dispatch typed yes/no/none to the same handlers as card buttons, using the active card and paint identity. Do not let an old pending card suppress unrelated self-help.
findings.verification: Real Source Paint flat load with bump_rev=False, isolated Chrome 9731/test server 59879; zones unchanged by typed replies.

findings.title: Facet rebuild restores stale cards
findings.repro: Temporary sandbox with newer cards.jsonl and older cards.before_facets_20261003.jsonl; run generator --write with ROOT redirected to sandbox.
findings.observed: Newer deep correction and vocabulary replaced by backup contents. No real card files changed.
findings.suggestion: Derive from current cards; track and replace only generator-owned facet/syn additions. Preserve unrelated deep/manual fields and include an incremental-rebuild preservation test.

findings.title: Suggested acceptance rerun still contains visibility workaround bug
findings.observed: msr_verify and aibridge still hide Wire/Mask layers without _finishLayerVisibilityChange. Do not use the old 14/100 browser score as final-build success rate.
findings.suggestion: Correct the harness, use production loaders without page-side revision bumps, freeze source hashes/build and use unseen prompts. Score routing, emitted mutations, 2D output and spec/material evidence separately.

findings.title: Reported green commands can measure no cases or fail diagnostics silently
findings.observed: Bare adv_fp command in handoff tests 0 prompts. With explicit *prompts.txt: 284 prompts, 220 valid claims. Self-help holdout has 14 misses but exits 0 by design; t259 prints results without asserting exit failure.
findings.suggestion: Fail on empty fixture sets; separate diagnostic scoring from acceptance thresholds; make acceptance wrappers enforce recorded counts/assertions and preserve original snapshots.
